title: Lost all habits
body: Lost all habits randomly, would be good to have automatic backups to icloud instead of having to do it manually
author: NC D.

title: Simple and all that I really needed
body:
This tracker shows a total of 5 days tracked immediately when you open it which is motivating. You can set a custom time i.e. complete a habit 3 times in 10 days. It is quite hard to come at 100% - 91 consecutive completetions but at that point the tracker has already helped you to seal the habit.
Can set custom notification time as a reminder... I personally don't need more.
Thanks:)
author: Kanhanox
